name: Gangtok & Pelling Scenic Tour
description: Experience the untouched charm of Sikkim with this thoughtfully curated journey covering Gangtok and Pelling. A perfect blend of scenic landscapes, spiritual landmarks, and cultural immersion.
route: Siliguri/Bagdogra → Gangtok → Tsomgo Lake → Pelling (via Namchi) → Return
highlights: Visit the stunning Tsomgo Lake at 12,400 ft
Explore the sacred Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir
Enjoy panoramic views from Tashi Viewpoint
Experience the beauty of Pelling Skywalk & Pemayangtse Monastery
Visit serene lakes, waterfalls, and traditional villages

itinerary.title: Arrival & Transfer to Gangtok
itinerary.desc: Arrival at NJP/Bagdogra. Drive to Gangtok (4–5 hours). Check-in and relax. Evening explore MG Marg. Dinner included.

itinerary.title: Excursion to Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir
itinerary.desc: Drive to Tsomgo Lake, a breathtaking glacial lake. Continue to Baba Mandir. Return to Gangtok.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Local Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Visit Tashi Viewpoint, Ganesh Tok, Hanuman Tok, Institute of Tibetology, Do-drul Chorten, Gonjang Monastery, Ban Jhakri Waterfalls.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Pelling via Namchi
itinerary.desc: Drive to Pelling via Namchi. Visit Siddheshwar Dham and Sai Temple. Check-in at Pelling hotel.

itinerary.title: Pelling Full-Day Sightseeing
itinerary.desc: Visit Darap Village, Rimbi Waterfalls, Khecheopalri Lake, Pemayangtse Monastery, Rabdentse Ruins, and Skywalk.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: After breakfast, proceed to NJP/Bagdogra for your onward journey.

inclusions: Private vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing
Driver allowance, toll tax, parking fees, permits
